source_claim: AlphaEvolve repeated experiments and ablations depend on controlled model calls, seeds, and budgets, but request-parameter logging is not by itself proof that stochastic provider sampling behavior is replayable or deterministic.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve logs normalized request parameters, prompt hashes, output hashes, backend/model/API-mode telemetry, supported temperature/top-p/stop telemetry, supported seed-field telemetry, provider diagnostics boundaries, and provider-output replay boundaries. It does not claim a backend/API-mode seed-support matrix, provider model-revision stability records, provider system-fingerprint stability records, repeated identical-call fixtures, a deterministic output replay contract, same-prompt same-parameter output-match reports, or cross-provider seed-semantics reports.
